rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 1.62 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon.

Four eligible species (site-bound lichens, forest-associated, with felling-relevant threats such as lack of continuity forest and old trees) are recorded 558-561 m from the polygon, all in 2023 with 10 m uncertainty: Gyalecta ulmi (EN), Bellicidia incompta (EN), Inoderma byssaceum (VU) and Gyalecta flotowii (VU). None within 250 m.
Two further site-bound forest NT lichens (Caloplaca lucifuga, Lecanographa amylacea) are recorded at 558 m. This is fewer than 3 and beyond 250 m.

Effort is below the county median (69 records within 1000 m vs median 80). Near-site there are 0 records inside the polygon and 0 within 250 m (county median within 250 m: 2). The absence of near-site records is therefore weak evidence.

uncertainties: The records are evidence of recording, not of occupancy of this polygon today.
Low near-site effort means the lack of records within 250 m cannot be read as absence of species.
The lichen records are tightly clustered at 558-569 m, so they may reflect one surveyed location rather than the surrounding area.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for old or large trees and continuity-forest values, given the EN and VU lichens at about 560 m. A field visit is useful because near-site recording is absent.
